      446+
      let currentCategoryId = null;
      447+
      448+
      function initHome() {
      449+
      const grid = document.getElementById('categories-grid');
      450+
      grid.innerHTML = '';
      451+
      storeData.categories.forEach(cat => {
      452+
      const card = document.createElement('div');
      453+
      card.className = 'category-card';
      454+
      card.onclick = () => openCategory(cat.id, cat.name);
      455+
      card.innerHTML = `
      456+
      <div class="category-icon">${cat.icon}</div>
      457+
      <h3>${cat.name}</h3>
      458+
      `;
      459+
      grid.appendChild(card);
      460+
      });
      461+
      }
      462+
      463+
      function openCategory(categoryId, categoryName) {
      464+
      currentCategoryId = categoryId;
      465+
      document.getElementById('home-view').classList.add('hidden');
      466+
      document.getElementById('product-view').classList.add('hidden');
      467+
      document.getElementById('category-view').classList.remove('hidden');
      468+
      469+
      document.getElementById('category-title').innerText = categoryName;
      470+
      471+
      const grid = document.getElementById('products-grid');
      472+
      grid.innerHTML = '';
      473+
      474+
      const products = storeData.products[categoryId] || [];
      475+
      products.forEach(prod => {
      476+
      const card = document.createElement('div');
      477+
      card.className = 'product-card';
      478+
      card.onclick = () => openProduct(prod);
      479+
      card.innerHTML = `
      480+
      <div class="product-img-container">
      481+
      <img src="${prod.img}" alt="${prod.name}" class="product-img">
      482+
      </div>
      483+
      <div class="product-info">
      484+
      <h3>${prod.name}</h3>
      485+
      </div>
      486+
      `;
      487+
      grid.appendChild(card);
      488+
      });
      489+
      }
      490+
      491+
      function openProduct(product) {
      492+
      document.getElementById('category-view').classList.add('hidden');
      493+
      document.getElementById('product-view').classList.remove('hidden');
      494+
      495+
      document.getElementById('detail-img').src = product.img;
      496+
      document.getElementById('detail-title').innerText = product.name;
      497+
      document.getElementById('detail-desc').innerText = product.desc;
      498+
      }
      499+
      500+
      function goHome() {
      501+
      document.getElementById('category-view').classList.add('hidden');
      502+
      document.getElementById('product-view').classList.add('hidden');
      503+
      document.getElementById('home-view').classList.remove('hidden');
      504+
      }
      505+
      506+
      function goBackToCategory() {
      507+
      const categoryName = storeData.categories.find(c => c.id === currentCategoryId).name;
      508+
      openCategory(currentCategoryId, categoryName);
      509+
      }
      510+
      511+
      window.onload = initHome;
      512+
      </script>
      513+
      </body>
